name: NetBeans build descriptor tampering
description: Model malware modifying a NetBeans Ant build descriptor to inject unauthorized build logic, causing malicious code to be compiled into generated JAR artifacts.

placeholders.BUILD_FILE: relative path to the NetBeans build-impl.xml file being modified
placeholders.ORIGINAL_BUILD_TARGET: existing build target or supported insertion point in the build descriptor

preconditions: project contains a NetBeans Ant build descriptor such as build-impl.xml
the attacker can modify the build descriptor before compilation
the build system processes the modified descriptor
the operator engine supports the specified build_target locator and replace mode
